_comment: Admission-shim config EXAMPLE (copy to footprint_table.json and edit). Footprints are MEASURED GPU-dedicated deltas, not estimates: load the model alone, read '\GPU Adapter Memory(*)\Dedicated Usage' before and after (scripts/measure-fit.ps1 helps). Each footprint is only valid at 'measured_ctx'; the shim warns at startup if a plane's live recipe_options.ctx_size drifts from it.
_budget_note: Total iGPU carve minus a reserve. This example machine: 112 GB usable carve - 12 GB reserved.
_slack_note: Per-resident-model allowance for growth past the load-time delta. Measured here: ~1.1 GB/model; 1.5 is deliberately conservative.
_busy_note: If an eviction candidate is is_busy/is_streaming, wait up to busy_wait_seconds for it to go idle, then evict. Still busy at timeout -> REFUSE with 503, never force-evict a live generation. 0 = fail fast.

A.engine_pin_reason: llamacpp-rocm#123 corrupts DENSE models on gfx1151 from b1298 on (empty output at depth). MoE models are unaffected. Pin dense planes to b1297 until it is fixed.

B.engine_pin_reason: MoE models are unaffected by llamacpp-rocm#123, so this plane may track newer builds.

C.engine_pin: local rdna-boosts fork build (stew675 patches incl. qwen4exp MTP; unmerged upstream as PRs 27836/28243/28118)
C.engine_pin_reason: qwen4exp MTP needs the locally-built fork engine until the upstream PRs merge. Localhost-only bind; reachable via this shim.

models.name: classifier-E4B
models.notes: Small always-on classifier driven by scheduled automations. Reload is only ~6s, but it is cheap to keep and expensive to be missing, so it is evicted only as a last resort.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B-Q6-MTP
models.notes: Dense Q6 + external Q4_0 MTP drafter (n8 p0.5), vision+video. Dense -> must stay on plane A / b1297 (see planes.A.engine_pin_reason).

models.name: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-MTP-GGUF
models.notes: Registered on both planes on this machine; the plane-A registration is a leftover and must never be routed to - which is why plane ownership is explicit config, not discovery.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b-mxfp-GGUF
models.notes: Also dual-registered; same explicit-ownership rule as the 122B.

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTP
models.notes: MEASURED at 262k ctx: 61.2 target + 3.2 draft + 8.75 KV (incl. QSA indexer) + ~2 compute. The 26.8 GiB PLE n-gram table lands in HOST mmap, not the carve. Requires the fork engine (stock engines fail with: unknown model architecture 'qwen4exp'). MTP draft accept 90-100% with p_min 0.75.
